effects.name: psychedelic-fractal-vortex
effects.notes: A bold kaleidoscopic fractal vortex bends the source into rotating color symmetry, with bass expansion, midrange rotation and high-frequency sparkles.
effects.prompt: bold audio-reactive psychedelic fractal tunnel over the image with rotating kaleidoscopic symmetry, liquid radial distortion, rainbow cycling, recursive-looking geometry and glowing trails; bass expands, mids rotate and highs sparkle

effects.name: drifting-embers
effects.notes: Sparse, softly glowing motes rise slowly behind the scene with parallax layers, gentle sway and slow twinkle.
effects.prompt: slow glowing particles drifting upward behind the scene, like embers or dust catching light, sparse and calm

effects.name: submerged-caustics
effects.notes: Slow layered caustic ripples with gentle refractive lensing and palette-tinted underwater light bands.
effects.prompt: make the background look like light refracting underwater: slow caustic ripples playing across everything, gentle lensing

effects.name: crt-phosphor-drift
effects.notes: Emulates an old CRT: slow rolling scanlines with a drifting bright band, radial chromatic fringing, soft phosphor bloom and a gentle vignette.
effects.prompt: old CRT monitor: rolling scanlines, slight chromatic aberration at the edges, soft phosphor glow and a gentle vignette

effects.name: high-window-lightshaft
effects.notes: A soft diagonal sun shaft with slowly turning dust motes drifting inside it, added over the scene without hiding it.
effects.prompt: a soft shaft of light falling diagonally across the scene with slow dust turning inside it, like sun through a high window

effects.name: aurora-veil-curtains
effects.notes: Soft vertical aurora curtains breathe slowly across the upper part of the scene, tinted from the palette and added as gentle light.
effects.prompt: a faint aurora veil breathing slowly across the upper half of the scene, soft vertical curtains, never harsh

effects.name: rain-streaked-glass
effects.notes: Droplets and slow-running trails on a pane of glass, refracting the scene through soft defocus with palette-tinted highlights.
effects.prompt: looking through a rain-streaked window: droplets refracting the scene, slow trails running down, soft defocus between them
